description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans serialization support for C# record types. It verifies serialization and deserialization of various record structures, inheritance hierarchies, and complex nested records, ensuring efficient and correct behavior within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: RecordSerializationTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing Orleans' serialization of C# record types, including various scenarios like empty abstract records, inheritance, nested records, and collections.

classes.name: EmptyAbstractRecord
classes.description: An abstract record with no members, serving as a base record for inheritance tests.

classes.name: DerivedFromEmptyAbstractRecord
classes.description: A concrete record inheriting from EmptyAbstractRecord, with an 'Foo' property.

classes.name: NonEmptyAbstractRecord
classes.description: An abstract record with a 'Bar' property initialized by constructor.

classes.name: DerivedFromNonEmptyAbstractRecord
classes.description: A concrete record inheriting from NonEmptyAbstractRecord, adding a 'Foo' property.

classes.name: RecordHierarchyDerived
classes.description: A record inheriting from RecordHierarchyMiddle, adding a 'Message' property and overriding 'Type' property.

classes.name: RecordHierarchyMiddle
classes.description: An intermediate abstract record in a hierarchy with no additional members.

classes.name: RecordHierarchyBase
classes.description: Base abstract record with an abstract 'Type' property.

classes.name: FooWithListOfObject
classes.description: A class with list of objects and a FooRecord property for serialization testing.

classes.name: TwoObjects
classes.description: A class with two object properties to test serialization of object references.

classes.name: FooWithListOfFruit
classes.description: A class holding a list of FruitRecord and a FooRecord for serialization tests.

classes.name: FooWithListOfApple
classes.description: A class holding a list of AppleRecord and a FooRecord for serialization tests.

classes.name: FruitRecord
classes.description: A record representing a fruit with a name.

classes.name: AppleRecord
classes.description: A record inheriting from FruitRecord, representing an apple with a name.

classes.name: FooRecord
classes.description: A record with a GUID Id property, representing a simple identifiable object.

methods.name: RecordSerializationTests
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependency injection container and serializer.

methods.name: CanSerializeEmptyAbstractRecord
methods.description: Test serializing and deserializing an empty abstract record.

methods.name: CanSerializePopulatedAbstractRecord
methods.description: Test serializing and deserializing a derived abstract record with data.

methods.name: CanSerializeRecordsWithEmptyHierarchyLayers
methods.description: Test serialization of a record with inheritance hierarchy, verifying structural integrity.

methods.name: CanSerializeRecordsInList
methods.description: Test serialization of a list of records.

methods.name: Can_Roundtrip_WithListOfObject_Fruit
methods.description: Verify serialization/deserialization correctness for list of object records.

methods.name: Can_Roundtrip_With_Them_Apples
methods.description: Verify serialization/deserialization of records containing AppleRecord objects.

methods.name: Can_Roundtrip_WithListOfObject_Apple
methods.description: Test serializing list of AppleRecord objects within a parent class.

methods.name: Can_Roundtrip_WithListOfFruit_Fruit
methods.description: Test serializing list of FruitRecord objects within a parent class.

methods.name: Can_Roundtrip_WithListOfFruit_Apple
methods.description: Test serializing list of AppleRecord objects within a parent class.

methods.name: Can_Roundtrip_WithListOfApple_Apple
methods.description: Test serializing list of AppleRecord objects specifically, ensuring inheritance is handled.

methods.name: Can_Roundtrip_Fruit_Apple
methods.description: Test serialization/deserialization of a record inheriting from FruitRecord, AppleRecord.

methods.name: Can_Roundtrip_Foo
methods.description: Test serialization/deserialization of FooRecord with a Guid property.
